export_changes: Rename OSM-recorded to osm_matched and reorder columns to the manuscript schema; all record values and row order are preserved.
osm_match_definition: Maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching within 100 m against GOWIRES within the common comparison boundary; existing assignments are preserved, not recomputed.
year_definition: First-observed presence in the sampled historical imagery; not an exact construction date.
